metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · Wednesday
metas.description: Follows Wednesday Addams' years as a student, when she attempts to master her emerging psychic ability, thwart a killing spree, and solve the mystery that embroiled her parents.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · My Demon
metas.description: A pitiless demon becomes powerless after getting entangled with an icy heiress, who may hold the key to his lost abilities -- and his heart.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Lucky Guy
metas.description: The series dives into the strange life of Lucky, a college student who appears to have it all since birth, but now his luck has become a bane as he is faced with some of the most difficult situations of his life.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Lovely Runner
metas.description: Right after top star Ryoo Seon-jae ends his life, his top fan Im Sol somehow time-travels back to when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally...

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2023 · Twinkling Watermelon
metas.description: "Sparkling Watermelon" will tell the story of a boy living a double life between a model student and a band member who gets to time slip and meets his 18-year-old father. The two will build friendships there.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Marry My Husband
metas.description: A story about Ji-won who after being killed by her husband who had an affair with her best friend, goes back 10 years in the past and has a chance to change her fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · See You in My 19th Life
metas.description: Ban Ji-eun can remember all her past lives. When her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reunite with a man named Moon Seo-ha whom she met in her 18th life.
